topic: 命中关键字却报失败：修复早退消费者导致的 SIGPIPE
title: 命中关键字却报失败：修复早退消费者导致的 SIGPIPE
answer:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set +e
bash -- "$2" | grep -F -- "$1" >/dev/null
st=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
if (( st[0] != 0 )); then exit "${st[0]}"; fi
if (( st[1] == 0 )); then printf 'MATCH
'
elif (( st[1] == 1 )); then printf 'MISS
'
else exit "${st[1]}"; fi
```

提前退出的消费者会关闭管道；pipefail 不能区分预期早退与真正上游失败。使用会读完整个输入的固定字符串匹配，再立即保存各段退出码，优先保留生产者失败。

## 操作任务
监控包装器用 producer | grep -q 配合 pipefail，关键字在首行且后面数据很长时反而失败。实现 task.sh PATTERN PRODUCER：用 Bash 执行给定生产者脚本，按字面量查找 PATTERN，必须完整消费输出；生产者退出 0 时输出且仅输出 MATCH 或 MISS 加换行，退出 0。生产者非零退出时原样返回其退出码，不输出成功/未命中结论。生产者路径、模式可能含空格或以 - 开头；即使已找到关键字也不能吞掉后续生产者失败。

## 产物
提交 task.sh。不得把样例内容写死，也不得调用 Python 替代要求练习的 Bash 控制流。

平台实际启动 Bash，改变输入内容、退出码和分块时序，检查输出、退出码和协议边界。参考答案、初始故障和错误修复分别执行。

import os, pathlib, subprocess
bash=os.environ.get('OPSFORGE_BASH','bash')
worker=pathlib.Path('producer with spaces.sh')
def check(pattern, first, code, expected, result, filename='producer with spaces.sh'):
    global worker
    worker=pathlib.Path(filename)
    # Fixed prefix makes premature grep -q closure observable on every run.
    worker.write_text("set -e\nprintf '%s\\n' "+repr(first)+"\nfor ((i=0;i<2048;i++)); do printf '%0256d\\n' 0; done\nexit "+str(code)+"\n",encoding='utf-8')
    proc=subprocess.run([bash,'task.sh',pattern,str(worker)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8)
    assert (proc.returncode,proc.stdout)==(expected,result), (proc.returncode,proc.stdout,proc.stderr[-500:])
check('needle','needle',0,0,'MATCH\n')
check('[literal].*','[literal].*',0,0,'MATCH\n')
check('absent','nothing',0,0,'MISS\n')
check('-needle','-needle',0,0,'MATCH\n')
check('needle','needle',0,0,'MATCH\n','-producer.sh')
check('two words','two words',0,0,'MATCH\n')
check('needle','needle',7,7,'')
check('absent','nothing',23,23,'')

topic: 分块接收中 read 超时后仍须保留半条记录
title: 分块接收中 read 超时后仍须保留半条记录
answer:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
buffer=''; idle=0
while :; do
  part=''
  IFS= read -r -t 0.05 part
  rc=$?
  buffer+=$part
  if (( rc == 0 )); then
    printf '%s
' "$buffer"; buffer=''; idle=0
  elif (( rc > 128 )); then
    if [[ -n $part ]]; then idle=0; else ((idle+=1)); fi
    (( idle < 20 )) || exit 75
  else
    [[ -z $buffer ]] && exit 0
    exit 74
  fi
done
```

read 超时不代表丢弃已读取字符；非零返回时变量仍可能含部分数据。累计这些片段，只有读到换行才提交整条记录；EOF 尾部残片和读超时必须区别处理。

## 操作任务

import os, subprocess, time, queue, threading
bash=os.environ.get('OPSFORGE_BASH','bash')
def run(chunks, code, expected, keep_open=False):
    proc=subprocess.Popen([bash,'task.sh'],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    try:
        for data,delay in chunks:
            proc.stdin.write(data.encode());proc.stdin.flush();time.sleep(delay)
        if keep_open:
            proc.wait(timeout=3)
        proc.stdin.close();proc.stdin=None
        out,err=proc.communicate(timeout=3)
        assert (proc.returncode,out.decode())==(code,expected),(proc.returncode,out,err)
    finally:
        if proc.poll() is None:proc.kill();proc.wait(timeout=3)
run([('left',.15),(' right\\tail % 中文',.15),('\n\nnext\n',0)],0,'left right\\tail % 中文\n\nnext\n')
run([('complete\npart',.15),('ial',.15)],74,'complete\n')
run([],0,'')
run([('already\n',0)],75,'already\n',True)
proc=subprocess.Popen([bash,'task.sh'],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
received=queue.Queue()
def reader():
    for line in iter(proc.stdout.readline,b''):received.put(line)
thread=threading.Thread(target=reader,daemon=True);thread.start()
try:
    proc.stdin.write(b'ready\n');proc.stdin.flush()
    assert received.get(timeout=.7)==b'ready\n', 'complete record must arrive while input remains open'
    proc.stdin.write(b'next');proc.stdin.flush();time.sleep(.15)
    proc.stdin.write(b' line\n');proc.stdin.flush()
    assert received.get(timeout=.7)==b'next line\n'
    proc.stdin.close();proc.wait(timeout=2)
    assert proc.returncode==0
finally:
    if proc.poll() is None:proc.kill();proc.wait(timeout=2)
    thread.join(timeout=2)
